title: Reading China Customs trade data
text: cc_read_csv() warns several silent pitfalls download page: Truncation. portal caps download 10,000 rows. file exactly 10,000 data rows may incomplete, get warning. Encoding. column names decoded GB18030 (example file re-saved UTF-8), cc_read_csv() stops clear message; pass encoding = "UTF-8" override default. Mismatched columns. read several files share columns, get warning, affected rows filled NA. case described append single-month update dated series. One pitfall detected automatically: trade flow. Imports, exports combined “import export” downloads exactly columns – direction never stored file. read imports-file together exports-file, two merged without warning. Tag file binding need keep apart:
code: imports <- cc_read_csv("imports.csv") |> mutate(flow = "import") exports <- cc_read_csv("exports.csv") |> mutate(flow = "export") bind_rows(imports, exports)

text: Coming regular expressions match country names Chinese slightly involved languages. reason different parts world use different variants Chinese, beyond basic distinction simplified traditional characters. Mainland China, Malaysia Singapore use simplified characters whereas Hong Kong, Macau Taiwan continue use traditional characters – local usage may vary within group. especially true proper names like country names. can vary character character depending script used, might also reflect different (phonetic) transliterations refer another name altogether. examples case: Different scripts. Germany referred Deguo 德国 Mainland China 德國 Taiwan – 国 simplified character corresponding 國, easy. However, less obvious cases, see . Different transliterations. Many country names phonetically adapted languages translators every Chinese-speaking region taken artistic liberties . example, Hong Kongers refer Barbados Babaduosi 巴巴多斯 whereas people Taiwan call Babeiduo 巴貝多. Alternative names. Instead adapting country name according sound, Chinese-speaking people regions also opted convert original meaning country name Chinese. example, Montenegro Heishan 黑山 (“black mountain”) Mainland China. People Taiwan, hand, kept phonetic transliteration Mengteneigeluo 蒙特內哥羅. function countryname identifies country names Chinese converts various standardized output formats, ISO3 codes. uses regular expressions match country name variants simplified traditional Chinese: Methodology code conversion table can found repo.

Usually, name Chinese characters least error-prone. regular expressions fail capture province names, fuzzy matching using string distance based custom dictionary chinautils::province_dict likely get job done:
